Theorem
[Noncompact steady three-dimensional solitons] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0065 1. ch28:28.23\group Three-Dimensional Singularity Models

Every $\kappa $-noncollapsed nonflat complete noncompact three-dimensional steady gradient Ricci soliton is the Bryant soliton.
